title: Setup
nothing: Nothing is downloaded until you press the button.
playback.title: Video files need FFmpeg
playback.what: Files and direct video links are played with FFmpeg, a free open-source video program. It runs as its own program next to Minecraft.
playback.manual.title: Video files need FFmpeg
playback.manual.what: Files and direct video links are played with FFmpeg, a free open-source video program. Install it with your system's package manager, then press "Check again".
recording.title: Clips need FFmpeg
recording.what: Clips are recorded with FFmpeg, a free open-source video program, using your graphics card's video encoder. It runs as its own program next to Minecraft; it is the same download as for video screens.
recording.done: Done. The replay buffer records once you play.
recording.manual.title: Clips need FFmpeg
recording.manual.what: Clips are recorded with FFmpeg, a free open-source video program. Install it with your system's package manager, then press "Check again".
